Summary: The app provides no way to cancel a placed order.
Original comment: Poor app: Very poor web app when a person CANNOT Cancel an order.

Summary: App displays a menu item that had been removed six months prior, allowing the user to order and pay for a product that is no longer available.
Original comment: Not very accurate as for menu items available. Placed a delivery order just to find out an item was removed from the menu 6 months ago! After calling restaurant manager, was told they could not issue refund, because menus & app orders are corporate issue. Two hours later, with a cold Whopper still not eaten... Finally found someone to refund the $3.00 item that should have been removed from the menu 6 months ago! And NOBODY said sorry nor offered at least a $ off your next purchase coupon! 😞

Summary: App intermittently demands sequential phone and email verification codes mid-ordering; failing to enter them in time locks the card and blocks the purchase.
Original comment: The app is hit or miss! I usually add what I want to the app and my husband will go through the drive thru and all he has to do is pick what he wants, add it to the cart and click process order + complete for pickup! Then he goes through the drive thru and pick up the order. Every other time we have used the all recent has glitched and wanted to send a code to the phone then another to the email and if you don't get it fast enough it will lock whatever app or card you are trying to use!!!
